left.raw_text:
Inclusion Criteria:
- Critically ill cirrhotics  [AND] with early onset septic shock  [AND] (<24 hours) with norepinephrine
 [AND] of more than 10 ug/min and lactate >4 mmol/L

Exclusion Criteria:
  -  Patients with age less than 18 years
  -  Severe known cardiopulmonary disease (structural  [OR] or valvular heart disease, [OR]  coronary artery disease, [OR]  COPD)
  -  Severe coagulopathy platelets  [AND] <20,000 and INR >5
  -  Active Bleed (Mucosal  [OR] or variceal)
  -  Pregnancy
  -  Chronic kidney disease
  -  Extremely moribund  [AND] patients with an expected life expectancy of less than 24 hours
  -  Failure to give informed consent from family members

right.raw_text:
-  Hemodynamic instability requiring very high dose of vasopressors, late presentation  [OR] or spontaneous reversal of shock
  -  Patient enrolled in other clinical trials
